## Summary

Describe the user-facing behavior and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`
- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Tested on a relevant Android device/emulator, or explained why not

## Privacy, security, and performance

- [ ] No real SMS or account data is included
- [ ] No new permission, network path, telemetry, or third-party SDK
- [ ] Database/schema and upgrade impact considered
- [ ] Battery, memory, APK-size, and accessibility impact considered

## Screenshots

Include sanitized before/after images for visible UI changes, when applicable.
